title: Chapter 782
text:
The 3D star map showed the area of the Flickering World. In the black unexplored universe, there was a bright area. This was the rich Star Cluster that the detectors of the three Universal Civilizations had discovered in the desolate universe belt outside the Shattered Star Ring. It was named the Dawn Star Cluster, and it was the starting point for the exploration of the Flickering World.

The Dawn Star Cluster was the first area that the detectors had explored, and it was also the only Star Cluster that officially belonged to the Flickering World. As the bridgehead for the development of a new Star Field, it was marked in green. Further out was the gray unexplored area, which was extremely vast.

At first glance, the only Dawn Star Cluster that was lit up was like a lonely island in the middle of a vast ocean.

Developing a new Star Field was a huge project that could not be completed overnight. After all, the actual development was different from astronomical observation.

The Red Empire spent more than ten years to obtain the Dawn Star Cluster from the Radiant Federation and defined it as the starting point of the new Star Field. Due to the conflict between the two parties, the development had been stagnant. However, the astronomical observation of the three Universal Civilizations was not idle. After more than ten years of observation, they had roughly defined the territory of the Flickering World and completed the initial map.

In the star map given by the Red Empire, the Flickering World was roughly divided into nineteen Star Clusters of various sizes. The Dawn Star Cluster only took up three percent of the entire Star Field, and the rest were all unexplored areas.

Desolate universes were divided into sizes. A Star Field would usually include many small and medium desolate universe belts, and only super large desolate universe belts were defined as the borders of a Star Field. The Flickering World was not an exception. It was estimated that there were more than seven thousand small and medium desolate universe belts scattered between Star Zones and Star Systems.

Therefore, to the dynasty exploration team, the selection of an area was very important. If the direction of exploration was filled with desolate universe belts, the profits and benefits would be pitifully low.

"The dynasty has decided to first explore the three Star Clusters adjacent to the Dawn Star Cluster." Zoel zoomed in on the star map and showed it to them. "They are the Renault Star Cluster, the Garu Star Cluster, and the Crown Star Cluster."

Han Xiao, Heber, and the Klent representative all focused on the star map. This was a preliminary star map for astronomical observation. Due to the complicated universe environment, there would be some errors, but the general distribution of the planets would not be wrong.

Among the three Star Clusters, the Garu Star Cluster was the largest. It had many desolate universe belts, while the other two were average.

There were two types of desolate universe belts. One type was where the planets were sparse and spaced far apart from each other, or where there was a lack of stellar systems and certain high-energy celestial bodies. It was a barren area that could be discovered through astronomical observation. The other type was where the planets in the area were generally barren of resources. This type was more obscure than the former. It looked like a normal area, but in fact, it required field exploration to determine that it was a desolate universe belt.

At this time, although the star map had a rough distribution, the information of every planet was in an unknown state. This was a semi-finished star map. The Red Empire's development was to complete the detailed information of every planet in the star map through field exploration, correct astronomical errors, and occupy the rich planets in advance.

That was the job of the exploration team. Even if it was an obvious barren universe belt, they had to explore it.

There were countless planets in a star field. Even if the empire only planned to explore three star clusters, it would still be a huge project.

"Renault Star Cluster." Heber looked at it for a while and made his choice.

The Bloodshed Land and the Klent Kingdom advanced and retreated together, exploring the same area together.

"Black Star, what about you?" Zoel turned around.

Han Xiao stroked his chin. "I'll choose the Garu Star Cluster."

"Garu, huh? This area has the fewest people … Sure." Zoel nodded.

Han Xiaoxin smiled.

He and Heber had agreed to explore separately and not interfere with each other. Furthermore, he knew that among the three Star Clusters, the Garu Star Cluster had the most potential benefits.

It seemed like the Garu Star Cluster had more desolate universe belts than the other two Star Clusters, but in reality, the other two Star Clusters also had quite a number of desolate universe belts. In the desolate universe belt of the Garu Star Cluster, there were even some ruins of galactic civilizations that had great archaeological value.

In terms of resources, the Garu Star Cluster was slightly larger and had many stellar systems. It also had more habitable and resource rich planets. In terms of species, the Garu Star Cluster had more intelligent civilizations, and most of them were still at the surface civilization stage. It was more convenient to explore.

In his previous life, the Garu Star Cluster was one of the most prosperous Star Clusters in the Flickering World and was very suitable for investment. Therefore, Han Xiao decided to develop the Garu Star Cluster after comprehensive consideration.

There was another important reason. The ownerless Universal Treasure that existed in the Flickering World in Han Xiao's memories was located in a desolate universe belt near the Garu Star Cluster. It did not belong to the dynasty's first exploration phase. It would be more convenient for him to go there if it was close.

Other than me, no one knows about the existence of this Universal Treasure for now. Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

He was determined to obtain this item.

This time, a mission notification popped up on the interface.

You have triggered Grade S + Mission Series [Flickering World].

Mission Introduction: Flickering World. A new Star Field represents a new structure. Exploring this Star Field is both your responsibility and your opportunity.

Tip: Mission Requirements, Mission Rewards, Exploration Points, and Mission Rating depend on your faction.

You belong to the Red Empire Faction or the Black Star Corps Faction.

Mission Requirements: Explore the Flickering World for the Red Empire as a member of the Black Star Corps.

You have received the first round of exploration.

Current Exploration Area: Garu Star Cluster

Personal Exploration Points: 0

Total Exploration Points: 0

Current Rating: E-

Remarks: Mission Rewards depend on Mission Rating, and Mission Rating depends on Total Exploration Points.

Exploration Points come from the results of exploration, such as completing a planet's field exploration, perfecting planet information, correcting star map errors, successfully setting up an area observation buoy, discovering civilization ruins, discovering planet history, coming into contact with intelligent species, operating strongholds, discovering habitable planets and resource planets, discovering rare resources, and so on.

"Flickering World Main Storyline Mission!" Han Xiao was excited.

This Main Storyline Mission was very large in scale, and the mechanism was very complicated. It was a combination of Chain Missions and Faction Series Missions, and its difficulty was S +.

First of all, the details of this mission would change depending on the faction. Not all players were members of the Red Empire. After the Flickering World was opened, the players of the various Star Fields represented different organizations, and their exploration areas were different. The reward system was also different.

For example, the Red Empire's exploration area was larger, which meant that the difficulty was higher.

For example, the Exploration Points were divided into individual and total Exploration Points. Individual Exploration Points were the result of one's own efforts. Every time one accumulated a certain amount of Exploration Points, they would be rewarded. The Red Empire's Exploration Points standard was higher than the other factions, but the rewards were also more generous.

The Total Exploration Points were the sum of the individual Exploration Points of the players of the same faction. It required the players of the same faction to work together, and there were also periodic rewards. The Total Exploration Points were linked to the Mission Rating. When the Total Exploration Points were enough to raise the Mission Rating by a small level, all the players of the same faction would receive the reward, which would be distributed according to the Exploration Points of the players.

Every exploration area was equivalent to one of the Chain Missions. After the exploration of the area was completed, the reward would be calculated according to the Mission Rating. After changing to a new exploration area, the Total Exploration Points and Personal Exploration Points would be reset to zero. The S + Overall Mission [Flickering World] would only be calculated after the entire Star Field was explored. The reward would be calculated according to the Exploration Points and Mission Rating of each exploration area.

Han Xiao rolled his eyes. The exploration had not officially started yet. With this mission, he could distribute it to the army members in advance.

At the same time, he could let the players know that they had a new Main Storyline after the secret war.

After talking about business, the star map flashed, and the chip on Zoel's wrist returned.

"I'll report your intentions to the dynasty. There shouldn't be any problems," Zoel said with a smile.

The Shattered Star Ring was the closest to the Flickering World, and the allies in this area were the first echelon of exploration.

"There's one more thing." Zoel looked at Han Xiao. "The first batch of elites to be modified by the Evolution Cube has followed the dynasty's transport team into the Shattered Star Ring and will arrive at the Colton Star Cluster soon. Black Star, don't forget to welcome them. The transport team has the first batch of resources that the dynasty will give you."

"Hmm, I'll go back after the meeting." Han Xiao nodded and curiously asked, "Who are the first batch of people to be modified?"

"I have a list here. You can take a look at it." Zoel casually sent him a set of information.

Opening the list, Han Xiaoxin glanced at it.

There were a total of thirty thousand people on the list, all of whom were military elites selected by the dynasty. At the very front of the list, there were indeed more than one familiar name.

One of the names left a deep impression on him.

"One of the future dynasty marshals … Teny Amenos?"

Han Xiao's eyes widened slightly.

This time, Zoel continued. "After this batch of elites is modified, a small portion of them will stay behind to participate in the development of the Flickering World, while the majority will return to the dynasty to continue training. You can go with them to the Central Galaxy to meet the upper echelons of the dynasty … Black Star? Black Star? "

"Oh." Han Xiao recovered. "I heard that. Let's do that."

"Okay." Zoel did not think much of it and nodded. "That's all. I have nothing else to say."

Everyone nodded, and Han Xiao left Heber's palace, still thinking about what they had just discussed.

…

Returning to the suite, Han Xiao had just sat down when someone knocked on the door. Hella opened the door, and a few people were standing outside.

These people were the representatives of the other Star Cluster civilizations in the Shattered Star Ring. Seeing that Han Xiao had returned, they immediately chased after him. The moment Han Xiao stepped into the room, they immediately came to visit.

"Your Excellency Black Star, we hope to have a chat with you," one of them said with a smile.

"Please come in." Han Xiao invited them in. He was well aware of their intentions.

As expected, after chatting for a while, the topic changed to the Evolution Cube.

However, these people were just the beginning. Following which, the representatives of the various organizations that had participated in the Tyrant's Party came to visit.

Very soon, ninety-five percent of the people in the guest castle had arrived.

The huge suite instantly became crowded.

The Evolution Cube was a rare commodity, and everyone wanted to have a share of it.

The Tyrant's Party was originally an event for Heber to consolidate his influence, and the guests were all important figures in the Shattered Star Ring. This made it convenient for Han Xiao to expand his network.

Taking advantage of this opportunity, Han Xiao also formally discussed cooperation with the various organizations.

"Regarding the Evolution Cube, the Red Empire did not restrict my use of it. If you want to borrow it, it's not impossible, as long as you can satisfy my conditions …"

Han Xiao's tone was filled with a smile.

All the important figures in the room quietened down and listened quietly. Only Han Xiao's voice was left in the room.

Ames watched this scene from outside the crowd. Her eyes were fixed on Han Xiao, who was talking among the crowd, and a strange smile appeared in her eyes.

"You're really suitable for managing an organization …"
